panels.caption: TAVI Setup › Agents › Remove from Desk: the replacement picker covers open tickets only; SLA escalations are counted and the agent is simply removed from them
Zoho Desk help "Adding and managing agents" › Deleting agents (not live): the admin picks another agent, and that agent replaces the deleted one in "whom to escalate"

rows: The admin chooses a replacement agent, used for open work and for rules, including SLA escalations
Replacement offered for open tickets only
The chosen agent is put into "whom to escalate"; the escalation keeps notifying someone
The agent is just removed ("stop naming this agent"); a level that named only them is left with no one to notify
